name: Montalcino (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with a green holm oak tree rising from a red mount of six hillocks (the arms of Montalcino), with the name MONTALCINO in black beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Montalcino, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: mount of six hillocks beneath the tree
